title: Louie Christopher Wee
text:
I am an Analyst based in Calgary, Alberta.
 I am currently pursuing the Canadian Securities Course (CSC) and Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300) certifications.
 I recently completed the Investment Funds in Canada (IFC), and Post-Baccalaureate Diploma in Data Analytics and Marketing at Okanagan College (Ranked #1 with GPA of 95%).
 I worked as a Research Officer at CTS Global Equity Group for 5 years,
focusing on market sentiment, risk management, and analysis of global equity markets.
 I enjoy traveling, food and sports.
 Check out what I’m working on!

Whitehorse, Yukon
